title: Satisfyingly Chaotic
description: An extremely chaotic mod which is a little satisfying sometimes.
body:
# Satisfyingly Chaotic
## Pure Chaosness come true with satisfaction

Well you may be wondering, "chaotic"? What? What is so chaotic about an innocent Modrinth mod? Oh well, the answer is: a lot of things. Firstly at adds some entities that include:
- GGGE - A failed science experiment
- Basement Kid - An entity born as a child isolated within an endless basement. Watch out, as these entities don't like visitors!

And also it adds two new bombs:
- Compressed Explosive - Many TNTs compressed into one single explosive that explodes in a satisfying way, which is why this mod has the word "Satisfyingly" in the name.
- Nuclear Bomb - A very destructive bomb which is not very performance friendly. It is very overpowered, so be careful with it

Not only that, but it also adds the quantum tunneler, the library and a few more mysterious things in which you will find more information in the library as well as crafting recipes (the quantum tunneler has a secret recipe which you will need to some how find out). The library is also were you will find the lore of this mod (mostly).

Ah yes, and lastly Modrinth wants me to specify why someone would want to download this mod.
Well, the answer is: why not? Do you like chaos and dozens of random additions? Well, then this mod is for you!


Important note: since the mod is made using MCreator with a mix of custom Java code, we could not open-source the mod. If we will recreate this mod in pure Java code (only maybe. Maybe yes, maybe not), then we promise to open-source the mod.
